questions.question: Against which nations does Amos 1 pronounce judgment?
options: Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, and Ammon
questions.answer: Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, and Ammon

questions.question: What repeated phrase introduces each oracle?
options: 'Hear this word, O people, that the LORD has spoken against all of you'
'For three transgressions... and for four, I will not revoke the punishment'
'Thus says the king of the nations to all of those who dwell on the wide earth'
'Woe to the great and proud city that is wholly full of much bloodshed'
questions.answer: 'For three transgressions... and for four, I will not revoke the punishment'

questions.question: Amos was a herdsman from Tekoa who prophesied concerning Israel.
The LORD roars from Zion and utters his voice from _____.
For three transgressions of Damascus, and for _____, I will not revoke the punishment.
